highlights: Actual for Q2FY27: Revenue – INLINE; EBITDA Margin – MISS; PAT – MISS Change in Estimates post Q2FY27 (Abs) FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: 3%/3%; EBITDA: -8%/-7%; PAT: -14%/-12% Recommendation Rationale • Volume Recovery and Improving Pricing Environment: JK Lakshmi Cement is expected to witness a recovery in volume growth during H2FY27, with management targeting 7–8% growth, broadly in line with industry growth.
Cement demand has started improving after the monsoon, while price hikes implemented during September and October are expected to sustain, with further increases anticipated in November and December.

Improved volumes and realisations are likely to support revenue growth and profitability. • Margin Recovery through Cost Optimisation and Premiumisation: The company is targeting an improvement in EBITDA/tonne towards Rs 700+, supported by better cement realisations, improved operating leverage and lower power costs following the completion of planned shutdowns.
Management intends to maintain net debt-to-EBITDA within 3.5x, supporting sustainable long-term growth.
